scope: Recover interrupted source-test shutdown through authenticated read-only provider observations in the existing attempt journal.
riskAnalysis: Physical cleanup gates and serial sandbox admission consume append-only proof. Recovery grants no execution, acceptance, publication or financial authority. Original receipts remain unchanged by recovery.

threatModel.assets: Owner/workspace isolation, original trial evidence, revoked grants, physical sandbox shutdown and accounting.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Authenticated owner to server CAS; trusted provider GET metadata to immutable task-bound cleanup proof.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged stopped status, foreign sandbox, mutated manifest, replayed recovery, concurrent append, false acceptance or masking failed local destruction.
threatModel.mitigations: Server-only provider reads, exact project/name/session and immutable manifest/permit binding, current owner identity, revoked authority, CAS revalidation, hash-linked events, independent local destruction proof.

defects.rootCause: Provider find/stop/read cleanup can outlive the transport cleanup window, leaving a closed attempt with cleanup-unconfirmed despite later provider shutdown.
defects.detectionGap: No durable read-only reconciliation existed for source-test provider shutdown after the request ended.
defects.regression: Actual controller and CAS fixture plus adversarial owner, manifest, session, provider, concurrency and late-closure tests.
defects.historicalPrevention: Shared proof consumed by both physical cleanup and source-test serial admission. Snapshot observations remain distinct from original test receipts.

rollback: Disable recovery by reverting reviewed source changes; preserve appended receipts and original audit history. Never revive revoked grants or declare failed tests passed.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Reject missing, foreign or invalid provider observations before appending proof.
negativePaths.stale-state: Revalidate exact immutable manifest, permit, owner and task inside CAS; reject stale event chain.
negativePaths.concurrency: Concurrent same observation appends one event; actual controller organization-CAS regression.
negativePaths.cancellation: Interrupted GET writes no shutdown proof; subsequent read-only confirmation is safe.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Original worker may close late; snapshot hashes document observations without rewriting its receipt.
negativePaths.api-outage: Read errors remain unconfirmed, never imply shutdown.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Owner-only, exact workspace, all prior authority revoked and no active leases.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No new VM or model/count request; accounting retained unchanged.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Running provider or failed local workspace destruction remains blocked.

proactiveReview.architecture: Extends existing journal/controller; no new orchestration or provider mutation.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Uses existing provider find/read and existing task catalog profiles.
proactiveReview.threats: Physical proof cannot grant test acceptance or agent publication.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Provider shutdown and original test success are separate; 404 is not shutdown proof.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Timeout, late closure, malformed identities, active authority and concurrency covered offline.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent Work QA and Auditor approved final source after snapshot semantics and controller-CAS coverage were corrected.
proactiveReview.recovery: Append-only proof preserves original receipts, historical audits, approvals, grants and finances.
proactiveReview.readiness: Focused66 passed; expanded affected tests and exact-source hosted STRICT/Redis/security/browser qualification required before paid continuation.
